highlights: The AI agent landscape is rapidly advancing with new specialized capabilities for spec-first coding, autonomous vulnerability patching, and cybersecurity defense.
Significant progress in model development includes faster and cheaper multimodal generation (video), enhanced MoE architecture understanding, and crucial open-source efforts to reduce model bias.
Developer tools are improving infrastructure for LLM inference with Kubernetes-native control planes, hardware-specific performance optimizations, and better standards for model interoperability.

agents.title: Google AI Releases Elephant-Goldfish Model Plugin for Spec-First Coding
agents.summary: Google AI introduces the Elephant-Goldfish Model plugin, enabling coding agents to draft specifications and undergo a five-stage, zero-context review process before generating any code, promoting a robust spec-first development methodology.

agents.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
agents.summary: OpenAI has unveiled GPT-6 Cyber, a specialized cybersecurity model designed to identify exploitable vulnerabilities and develop fixes, explicitly trained to operate within authorized scopes, enhancing enterprise security.

agents.title: A thousand fewer paths to root
agents.summary: OpenAI developed an autonomous pipeline that successfully identified, validated, and generated patches for 948 local privilege-escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel, showcasing advanced agent capabilities in automated security remediation.

models.title: Google Releases Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: 15-Second AI Video at $0.07 per Second
models.summary: Google introduced Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, a video generation and editing model offering native 15-second clips, multi-turn conversational editing, and a 30% price reduction to $0.07 per second for 720p video, making high-quality video creation more accessible.

models.title: Nous Research Releases Arete-27B that Cuts Qwen3.8-27B Propaganda From 22% to 0.9%
models.summary: Nous Research released Arete-27B, an Apache 2.0 fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B, significantly reducing propaganda answers from 22% to 0.9% on their 803-prompt evaluation while maintaining strong performance on the Hermes Bench.

models.title: Which Routing Does Each MoE Model Use? DeepSeek, Qwen, Mixtral, Llama 4, gpt-oss Compared
models.summary: A comprehensive comparison details the token routing mechanisms of ten open Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, including their total/active parameters, expert counts, top-k selections, and load-balancing methods, providing critical insights for MoE architecture design.

tools.title: Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM
tools.summary: Buoyant launched Kinference, an Apache 2.0 open-source inference control plane for vLLM on Kubernetes, featuring declarative routing policies, KV-cache-aware load balancing, and per-tenant metrics, resulting in a 95% reduction in median Time To First Token (TTFT).

tools.title: Zyphra ZYFA: FP8 FlashAttention for AMD MI355X, Up to 1.76x Faster
tools.summary: Zyphra released ZYFA, open-source FP8 and BF16 prefill attention kernels optimized for AMD Instinct MI355X, delivering up to 1.76x faster performance on real model activations with significantly lower error rates.

tools.title: Transformers Model Integration Contracts
tools.summary: Hugging Face introduced Transformers Model Integration Contracts to standardize how models are integrated into the Transformers library, improving interoperability, maintainability, and simplifying the development experience for new and existing models.

companies.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
companies.summary: OpenAI announced the acquisition of Pierre Computer Company, Inc., aimed at expanding Codex's capabilities for building, understanding, and reviewing code, thereby enhancing developer tools and code intelligence offerings.

companies.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
companies.summary: OpenAI is collaborating with Hacktron to proactively identify vulnerabilities, rigorously test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses across its frontier AI systems, reinforcing its commitment to security.

companies.title: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
companies.summary: OpenAI introduced its National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint, outlining a framework to protect local resources, create jobs, and guide the responsible development of AI infrastructure.

learning.title: MoE Routing Strategies Explained: Top-K, Expert-Choice, Sigmoid Gating and Dynamic Routing (2026 Guide)
learning.summary: This 2026 guide explains seven key Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing strategies, from Mixtral's top-2 softmax to DeepSeek-V4's hash routing, detailing how experts process tokens and which models utilize each method, essential for optimizing MoE architectures.

learning.title: How to Run NVIDIA Dory 4B with llama.cpp: Loop by Loop Guide
learning.summary: A comprehensive coding guide provides step-by-step instructions for running NVIDIA's Dory 1.0 4B looped language model with llama.cpp, covering branch building, compute cost analysis, memory caching, and paired evaluations.

learning.title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
learning.summary: Australian universities are expanding access to ChatGPT and integrating AI into their teaching and learning frameworks, proactively preparing students for an AI-enabled workforce by fostering AI-native skill sets.
